title: XV de Piracicaba wins and eyes Copa Paulista knockout spot
seoTitle: XV de Piracicaba eyes Copa Paulista knockout stage
subtitle: Nhô Quim secured its first victory in the tournament and now depends only on itself to advance to the next stage in a crucial match.
excerpt: XV de Piracicaba shook up the sports scene with its first Copa Paulista victory. Now, they seek knockout stage qualification in a single match.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
XV de Piracicaba became one of the most talked-about topics in the sports world after its first Copa Paulista victory, a crucial 1-0 win over Comercial. This result placed Nhô Quim in a decisive position to qualify for the tournament's knockout stage, with a direct clash scheduled for this Saturday (22) at home.

The triumph that changed the scenario in Group 2

XV de Piracicaba's 1-0 victory against Comercial last Tuesday (18) in Ribeirão Preto marked the team's first triumph in the Copa Paulista group stage. The decisive goal came from a penalty kick, converted by Gabriel Chagas in the first half after a mistake by Comercial's goalkeeper Matheus Pelegrini. XV had the opportunity to extend their lead with another penalty, but Josiel missed the shot, hitting the post.

The game was described as very difficult, with Comercial chasing the result and XV taking advantage of their opponent's slip-ups. Comercial's head coach, Raphael Pereira, analyzed the defeat, admitting errors that led to the goal, but also recalled that Comercial had previously beaten Nhô Quim at the Barão da Serra Negra.

The standings in the Copa Paulista table

Despite the victory, XV de Piracicaba still sits at the bottom of Group 2 with five points. However, the result was fundamental for the team, which now depends solely on its own efforts to advance to the next stage. With the draw between União São João and Noroeste, Comercial qualified for the knockout stage, securing at least third place in the group, despite a three-game winless streak.

XV is tied in points with Noroeste, which also has five, while União São João is in second place with six points. Comercial temporarily leads the group with seven points.

Decision at home: XV seeks qualification

XV de Piracicaba's next challenge will be this Saturday (22) at 3:00 PM against União São João. The match, which is considered a "qualification game," will take place at the Barão da Serra Negra Municipal Stadium in Piracicaba. A victory will guarantee Nhô Quim a spot in the second stage of the state tournament.

For this decisive clash, the club's board expects massive support from its fans and a packed Barão. Tickets are already on sale, both at the stadium's ticket office and online via the Total Ticket website, with different prices for the Unimed, Setor 1, Aversa Motos, Honda Aversa, and Memorial sections.

Chasing back-to-back titles

With the possibility of advancing to the knockout stage, XV de Piracicaba continues the fight for its goal in the Copa Paulista: a consecutive back-to-back championship. In addition, the team is seeking the fourth title in its history in the competition, reinforcing its tradition in Paulista football.

The final round of the group stage will have all matches played on the same day and at the same time. While XV de Piracicaba faces União São João, Comercial will visit Noroeste at the Alfredo de Castilho stadium in Bauru (SP), also on Saturday (22).
